_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. Copyright (c) 3000 Galion / galion-studio. Featured connectors for the console /connectors screen (t453u). Each connector is an MCP server. Endpoints checked 2026-10-30 against the vendor docs in `source`. auth: token = owner pastes a key, stored 0600, sent as a Bearer header; oauth = needs a sign-in flow that is not built yet (TODO); builtin = configured in the Hermes config, not changed here.

connectors.name: Gmail
connectors.blurb: Search and read mail, draft replies.
connectors.note: Google Workspace MCP (Developer Preview). OAuth 2.0 with a Google Cloud client.

connectors.name: Google Calendar
connectors.note: Google Workspace MCP (Developer Preview). OAuth 2.0 with a Google Cloud client.

connectors.name: Google Drive
connectors.blurb: Search and read files, Docs, Sheets and Slides.
connectors.note: Google Workspace MCP (Developer Preview). OAuth 2.0 with a Google Cloud client.

connectors.name: Notion
connectors.token_label: Notion MCP token (Business/Enterprise workspaces; others need OAuth)

connectors.name: Slack
connectors.note: OAuth with a Slack app client ID.

connectors.name: GitHub
connectors.blurb: Repositories, issues, pull requests and code.
connectors.token_label: GitHub personal access token (fine-grained, read-only scopes)

connectors.name: Jira and Confluence
connectors.note: OAuth 2.1. API tokens only if an Atlassian admin enables them (header format not checked here).

connectors.name: Stripe
connectors.blurb: Payments, customers and the Stripe docs.

connectors.name: PayPal
connectors.token_label: PayPal access token (expires; from your app's client ID and secret)

connectors.name: OpenMind memory and vault
connectors.blurb: Hermes memory search and save, read-only Obsidian vault, stack status.
connectors.note: Live since 2026-10-29. Configured in the Hermes config; this screen does not change it.
